name: pAInapple Code
description: Installs the pAInapple Code WebSocket bridge for Claude Code. Exposes a password-gated web/PWA UI (default port 8765) that any browser — including iPad — can use to drive `claude` inside the container.

version.description: Git ref to install: branch, tag, or commit SHA (e.g. 'main', 'v1.0.0').

repo.description: Painapple Code repository URL. Override to install from a fork or mirror.

port.description: Port the bridge listens on (HTTP + WebSocket). Forward this port in devcontainer.json to expose the UI.

instanceName.description: Label shown in the PWA header (e.g. 'DEV', 'STABLE'). Useful when running against multiple codespaces.

accent.description: Accent color preset for the UI.

autostart.description: Start the bridge automatically on container start (via a systemd-less background launcher invoked from /etc/profile.d). Disable to start it manually with `painapple-code-start`.

installHelpers.description: Install the `shadow-git`, `shadow-query`, and `shadow-git-helper` agent into the container user's home.
